title: Pet actions v1
description: Read-only presentation-action hints Lynk (the Monitor) writes alongside pet-state.json, derived from the same activity projection, so a Pet/user-renderer can animate each agent without inferring behavior itself.

version.description: Semantic version of this contract payload.

generatedAt.description: When this envelope was produced. Matches the pet-state.json envelope it was derived alongside.

producer.description: Identifier of the process that produced this envelope, e.g. "lynk-monitor".

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing counter for the producer's process lifetime. Matches the pet-state.json envelope it was derived alongside.

actions.description: One entry per agent id also present in pet-state.json.

id.description: The agent id this action applies to; matches an id in pet-state.json's agents array.

parentId.description: The id of the Frontdoor root this Worker was delegated from. Null for a Frontdoor root itself.
